description: Create a NEW EQVPS customer account (first_name, last_name, email). Use a real email address you control — reserved/test domains such as example.com are not suitable (no recovery, no notifications). Returns a bearer `token` that is reusable for every request for 5 years (`token_expires_at`) — it is NOT single-use. Inside this MCP session the token is remembered automatically for the following tool calls. If you call the server with raw HTTP/curl instead, save the token to a file right away and send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on EVERY request — a shell variable does not survive separate commands. Never call register_account again to "get a new token": that creates another, empty account. Optional backup: call `set_password` once, then `login` (email + password) returns a fresh token if this one is lost. Requires: nothing. Typical error: 422 email already registered → use login or your saved token instead of a new account.
name: register_account
title: Register a new account
